product.audience: Israeli Hebrew speakers learning basic Spanish for travel in Spanish-speaking South American countries.
product.purpose: Understand people and respond in practical travel situations, including understanding the other person's questions and replies.
product.launch: Small project, initially free; paid options may be considered later.
product.course: One shared course and trip map rather than separate maps or courses for each country. Progression must respect language prerequisites rather than follow the literal chronology of arrival.
product.daily_budget: User chooses daily minutes. Save the current position when a whole unit does not fit; completion estimates depend on measured unit times, help and review needs.
product.dor_role: Dor knows Spanish from his trip and collaborates on dialogues, Hebrew explanations, audio and practical usefulness.

sequence: Prepare new vocabulary and fixed phrases with meaning and audio
Explicit short grammar primer and supported check before use
unit_contract.dialogue_length: Four to six utterances total; the first dialogue is particularly short.
unit_contract.load: One practical ability per unit, few new expressions, progressively reduced help, some units entirely review.
unit_contract.audio: All audio is Spanish only, including dialogues, questions, word tiles, model answers and any future spoken feedback. No Hebrew narration.
unit_contract.written_languages: Hebrew instructions, translations and grammar explanations; optional accessible Spanish text and subtitles.
unit_contract.media: Illustrated scene and characters, with small animations that clarify who speaks or the action without revealing answers to comprehension questions.
unit_contract.controls: Full dialogue replay, individual utterance replay and intelligible slower playback. Each character keeps a consistent voice; two voices suffice initially.
unit_contract.speech: Prepared speaking tasks include recorded automated pronunciation assessment requested by Dor on2026-10-16, with self-listening/model comparison still available. Validate acceptance against human judgment; plain STT is insufficient. Microphone/unavailable alternatives and progress rules need joint review.
unit_contract.accessibility: No beginner timer. Hints and text remain available; provide alternatives for users who cannot hear or record.
unit_contract.writing: No required free typing in the core course; word arrangement is useful support. Free writing and messages may be optional later.
unit_contract.feedback: Prioritize comprehension and communication. Offer one short useful hint or correction and another attempt. Distinguish hinted from independent success. ASR alone does not validate pronunciation, and an understandable Israeli accent is not failure.

exercise_bank: Understand the spoken question: identify whether it requests a name, country or price.
Listen and act: update a booking or traveler card using a heard detail.
Build a reply from familiar spoken word tiles.
Your turn: answer a familiar spoken question before revealing the model.
Change one already learned detail, such as name or number of nights.
Correct a misunderstanding after the required numbers and negation have been learned.
Swap roles only after the question itself has been learned for production.
Review in a new scene on another day, with no new content and less help.

units.content: Hola; understand ¿Cómo se llama?; Me llamo Dor; Gracias.
Understand ¿De dónde es?; Soy de Israel; review greeting and name.
¿Puede repetir, por favor?; reply to a familiar question.
No new material; name, origin and repetition.
Tengo una reserva; review giving the name.
Una / dos / tres noches; reservation review.
No new material; reservation, name and nights.
Diez / veinte / treinta; limited numbers within dialogue.
¿Dónde está el baño?; understand a short response such as Aquí.
La llave, por favor; familiar polite expressions.
No new material; select three familiar abilities, changed detail and optional recording.

planning_estimates.status: Planning estimates to validate in the pilot, covering the opening block only.

pilot.validation: Evaluate spoken-question comprehension, responses with and without hints, independent speech, changed familiar details and delayed retention. Measure enjoyment and load separately from learning. Compare practice combinations on the same content with similar time budgets.

language_and_grammar.base: Broadly understood standard Latin American Spanish; consistent tú, usted and ustedes; seseo; no vosotros or local slang in the core.
language_and_grammar.regional: Later short optional comprehension of vos, pronunciation and vocabulary variations. A Bogota voice was a candidate to audition, not an established easiest accent or final provider decision.
language_and_grammar.core_grammar: Useful present forms, questions, negation, want/need/can plus infinitive, hay versus tener, and limited gender/number agreement in context.
language_and_grammar.later: One planning form, ir a + infinitive; a few useful past phrases such as Ya pagué or Perdí mi mochila. Multiple past systems, present perfect, simple future and full conjugation tables are not opening requirements.
language_and_grammar.explanation_quality: Explain Me llamo as a whole; me is not always Hebrew 'I'. Do not use ser=permanent and estar=temporary as a universal rule or imply one-to-one mapping of Spanish verb groups to Hebrew binyanim.
language_and_grammar.comprehension_vs_production: A receptionist question may be more complex than the learner's short answer. Understanding it does not imply a requirement to produce it at the same stage.

later_content.catalog: 80 proposed communication situations in ten groups, retained as a planning resource rather than mandatory opening lessons.
later_content.reuse: Shared abilities recur across situations, rather than one separate lesson for every catalog record.
later_content.urgent_help: Useful prerecorded assistance phrases remain accessible before completing the relevant grammar.

ai_and_research.initial_delivery: Prepared, checked dialogues, branching interactions and prerecorded audio; limited live AI practice subject to measured cost.
ai_and_research.ai_role: Draft original dialogues and variations under human review; future practice constrained by role, task goal and already learned material.
ai_and_research.automatic_feedback: Selected as a pilot feature for prepared Spanish utterances by Dor on2026-10-16. Validate the dedicated pronunciation model against human judgments before acceptance thresholds. Azure es-MX/F0 is the researched feasibility candidate, not an empirically validated choice.
ai_and_research.research_basis_in_brief: Spaced practice, retrieval, guided listening, optional target-language subtitles, short explicit grammar explanations and corrective prompts. Product-specific timings and game mechanics remain pilot hypotheses.
ai_and_research.research_review_scope: Read selected primary course lessons, objectives and contents; Cervantes A1-A2 inventory sections; publisher abstracts of Spada and Tomita 2010 and Kim and Webb 2022. Scope and decisions documented in docs/curriculum/pilot-spec.json. No course completion or systematic literature review.

mobile_audio_debugging.symptom: Dor reports recording works visually; pressing playback shows playing for approximately a quarter second, no sound is heard, then the play action is available again.
verified_static_findings: App called player.pause even with an empty/idle player before starting recording. Installed expo-audio57.0.5 iOS AudioModule.pause schedules deactivateSession after100ms when keepAudioSessionActive is false; the guard checks players/playlists, not recorders. This can conflict with the new recording session.

Installed native recorder.stop resolves after stopRecording returns, before the separate didFinish delegate event. App loaded recorder.uri immediately rather than waiting for isFinished/url, so it could load an unfinished file.
SDK57 native recorder reuses its file when prepareToRecordAsync receives no options. Passing the preset explicitly creates a fresh file; a stable player with replace reloads the finished source.
mobile_audio_debugging.diagnosis_limits: These are verified implementation hazards and plausible causes, not a reproduction on Dor iPhone or proof of the sole cause. Original recording duration/content is unknown. Speaker route/device media volume/hardware behavior are not independently observed.

Await native stop plus finished-file event before playback source load; five-second completion timeout
